{{Quote|Hidden relics of the Force will give me the power I need to rise to the top of the ranks of the Sith.|Namman Cha|<ref name="card" />}}
'''Namman Cha''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and an aspiring [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] in league with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] who believed that he could become a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] through the discovery of ancient relics, like the [[Codex of Tython]]. He was an imposing warrior, calling for no quarter in a brutal attack. His hate had pushed him to learn to use a [[Shoto lightsaber/Legends|shoto]], a short-bladed lightsaber.<ref name="Card-SWGTCG-Double Bladed">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|cardname=Double Bladed}}</ref>

==Biography==
===Uncovering smuggling activities===
{{Quote|As I have shadowed Rebel movements in this sector, I see more and more of this Corellian pilot, Rendar, with each passing day.|Namman Cha|<ref name="DS2" />}}
From time to time Namman Cha, to his great disgust, was assigned by the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], to work in tandem with the [[Imperial Military|Imperial Forces]]. One such occasion involved the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] aiding the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] in uncovering a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Smuggler|smuggling]] operation. Shadowing the insurgents' movements in the vicinity of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], Cha saw the evidence of the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] pilot [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar's]] involvement in the scheme. The Dark Jedi preferred to simply destroy the traitor, but he was required to learn the smuggler's contacts first. Cha sent an undercover agent to follow Rendar,<ref name="DS2">{{SWGTCG|set=The Shadow Syndicate|scenario=Dark Side scenario campaign}}</ref> while he himself, accompanied by several of his [[Sith Shadows|Sith Shadow]] minions, attempted to get aboard his [[starship]], the [[YT-2400 light freighter/Legends|YT-2400 light freighter]] called [[Outrider/Legends|''Outrider'']]. Though their plans were ultimately foiled by the smuggler's security,<ref>{{SWGTCG|set=The Shadow Syndicate|scenario=Light Side scenario campaign}}</ref> the ISB operative successfully identified Rendar's Rebel contact as [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Coret Bhan]]. Pleased with the report, Cha sent the agent to follow the smuggler's vessel to uncover more of his activities.<ref name="DS2" />

===Operations in the Corellia system===
{{Quote|Lord Vader himself ordered me to destroy the Rebel base on Talus, and I intend to be very thorough.|Namman Cha|<ref name="SOC" />}}
Shortly before the [[Battle of Talus]], the Dark Jedi Cha was charged by the [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]], [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] himself, with uncovering and laying waste to the Rebel base on [[Talus]]. While investigating insurgent activity in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] per the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord's]] orders, he ambushed a meeting of Rebel agents in the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]. However, Cha was not aware that thanks to intelligence efforts, his adversaries were ready for the attack. The Dark Jedi and his underlings did not expect to find such a large number of Rebels, as well as several [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] operatives in the spaceport at the same time. After several of his minions were defeated, Cha ordered a retreat and escaped with a few of his adepts.<ref name="SOC">{{SWGTCG|set=Squadrons Over Corellia|scenario=Light Side scenario campaign}}</ref>

[[File:Reptomammal_Battle.jpg|left|thumb|Cha, fighting Hoth indigenous [[Wampa/Legends|wampas]]]]

===Search for the exiled Nightsister===
{{Quote|I have tracked a gifted Force-user to this worthless planet. A Nightsister from Dathomir.|Namman Cha|<ref name="LS">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|scenario=Light Side scenario campaign}}</ref>}}
While on a mission to the planet of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], the Dark Jedi Cha became interested in the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Kyrisa]], who had mastered the power of [[Animal bond|animal friendship]]. Sensing that her ability to control the beasts of Dathomir was special, he determined that the [[Witches of Dathomir|witch]] could become a powerful ally to the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] and intended to recruit her to their cause.<ref name="Card-SWGTCG-Watching the Witches">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|cardname=Watching the Witches}}</ref> However, before Cha could get to Kyrisa, she was exiled from the planet by the [[Clan mother/Legends|Clan mother]] [[Gethzerion]] for a failed attempt to claim the leadership of the clan.<ref name="Card-SWGTCG-Gone Forever">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|cardname=Gone Forever}}</ref> It took Cha some time to track her down, but eventually he determined that Kyrisa had crashed on the remote [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. The Dark Jedi contacted one of his Imperial agents to aid him in the search for the Nightsister and the two met on Hoth, where they agreed to check different search grids and stay in touch with each other.<ref>{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|scenario=Dark Side scenario campaign}}</ref>

[[File:Final_Clash.jpg|thumb|Cha and Kyrisa engaged in a lightsaber combat]]
During his search, Cha discovered that he wasn't the only one interested in Kyrisa. His old enemy, the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Rachi Sitra]], was also looking for the Nightsister, with the help of some Rebels from the small local outpost. After killing a local [[Hoth hog/Legends|Hoth hog]], the dark warrior was spotted by one of the Rebels and, after a brief conversation, attacked his competitor. However, the Rebel was able to knock the lightsaber out of Cha's hand and while the Dark Jedi made a leap to recover it, he admitted that as much as he would have fun killing the Rebel, finding the Nightsister was his first priority and time was of the essence. Cha left the Rebel be and continued his search of Kyrisa.<ref name="LS" /> He was soon back on her trail by following her beasts. The Dark Jedi found several [[Wampa/Legends|wampas]] and fought them, and eventually he found the Nightsister and, after a fierce lightsaber fight, persuaded her to join him.<ref name="Card-SWGTCG-Reptomammal Battle">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|cardname=Reptomammal Battle}}</ref><ref name="Card-SWGTCG-Final Clash">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|cardname=Final Clash|nobackup=1}}</ref>

[[File:NammanChaSWGTCGbyLasahido.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Namman Cha, a Jar'Kai practitioner]]

==Powers and abilities==
Namman Cha was adept at [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]], and regularly made use of dual lightsabers, displaying his use of [[Jar'Kai/Legends|Jar'Kai]]. He could also cast [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]], and was adept and many other [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]], such as [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force push]].

==Equipment==

Namman Cha used a modified [[Belbullab-22 starfighter/Legends|Belbullab-22 starfighter]] called the [[Sithspawn (starship)|Sithspawn]] during his missions.

[[File:Sithspawn.jpg|right|thumb|The ''Sithspawn''.]]
